description: How a post's views, forwards, replies and reactions (total and per-emoji) evolved over its life, as a sparse series of snapshots bucketed per hour or per day, oldest first — for view velocity and reaction drift. `message_id` comes from get_channel_posts. A post with no recorded snapshots answers an empty series.

bucket.description: Series resolution: one snapshot per hour (1h) or day (1d)

channel.description: Channel slug (Telegram username, without the @) or numeric channel id

since.description: Only snapshots taken at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp

until.description: Only snapshots taken before this ISO 8601 timestamp

name: get_post_stats

snapshots.description: Sparse, oldest first; empty for an untracked post

title: Interaction history of a post
